title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement
description:
arXiv:2611.13034v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent's current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable.
